test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c10b877d3c112c53114245fc4e54059e01a285a4a5bf70c6893f6fdc76daa687.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

From Figure (1) to (2):

The symbols C and K change into O and T, a line is added at the bottom and the arrow rotates 45º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91eb6d66f3a66244903c48b3e32f3833851fe27df3ed80c96fc47ff79c6586ec.png] 

From Figure (2) to (3):

A new symbol C is added, S changes into B, a line is added at the bottom and the arrow rotates 135º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a74bd8e07e814bb53dc5b2cb894e420891888cb1c51ec75a76b00c81de7e3ebe.png] 

From Figure (3) to (4):

The symbols C and T change into O and L, a line is added at the bottom and the arrow rotates 45º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db4afd1b9a20b5cb5653c05865f7627414079025afa3851bd55290e7843f6739.png] 

From Figure (4) to Answer Figure (5):

A new symbol C is added, S changes into B, a line is added at the bottom and the arrow rotates 135º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba7f97a9d4b61a27abec86ca438f57508ee7541052edf0b82d78d6b8cae58847.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
